role: A one-shot post-v199 classical-reference adequacy audit on the historically exposed p=14kw_size=01 development trajectory. It does not propose a deployable warm initializer and is not fresh validation, external generalization, test evidence, a resource result, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can one fixed, scale-equivariant edge-preserving Huber-PDHG refinement make the five-camera classical reference adequate on every p14 frame and calibration, so that the already-sealed v199 fixed-identity K1 result can be adjudicated against a valid reference?
physical_distinction: v200 does not tune the v199 identity ridge, affine coordinates, or CGLS depth. It applies a nonlinear local Huber gradient prior through a primal-dual solver, preserving flame-front edges rather than changing a global quadratic spectral filter.

data_isolation.calibration_indices: all integers 0 through 12 in immutable order

primary.name: scale_equivariant_huber_pdhg_reference_from_full_dct_k2
primary.starting_point: v199 full-DCT K2 reference field reconstructed without truth
primary.normalized_objective: 0.5*||B u-b||_2^2 + 0.001*sum Huber_0.08(|D u|_2), with x=field_scale*u and b=observation/observation_scale
primary.gradient: forward-Neumann differences on the physical field axes; spacings are divided by their geometric mean before use
primary.data_norm_squared_upper_bound: ||B||_1*||B||_infinity from the exact sparse physical operator
primary.initial_duals: zero data dual and zero edge dual

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.geometry_cache: operator assembly and the inherited affine/full-DCT factors are offline setup costs and must remain separate from logical online calls

required_validity_gates: all v199 arrays, p14 inputs, calibrations, five-camera selections, affine arrays, frame order, and observations remain unchanged
the prediction phase has no truth, metric, pass-mask, frame-time, trajectory-label, validation, or test input
formal and independent implementations separately rebuild sparse physical operators, K2 starts, normalized Huber-PDHG states, fields, observations, metrics, tails, and call ledgers
the formal K2 start reproduces every v199 five-camera K2 metric within 1e-8 absolute error
all fields, duals, steps, objectives, metrics, and summaries are finite and every PDHG step contract is strictly below one
camera and ray permutation preserve the Huber reference within 1e-9 relative error on the frozen sentinel
formal-independent fields and metrics agree within 1e-8 and discrete gates agree exactly
the formal tree and all parent/input trees remain unchanged before and after independent validation
fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, K2 reproduction, finite, step-contract, permutation, physical-replay, call-ledger, seal, or independent-comparison failure makes v200 inconclusive.

If the Huber-PDHG reference fails any strict cell or complete calibration group, conclude FAIL_HUBER_PDHG_REFERENCE_ADEQUACY_V200 and close this exact normalized Huber objective and 128-step solver without tuning.

If the Huber-PDHG reference passes all 1313 cells and 13 groups, conclude PASS_HUBER_PDHG_REFERENCE_ADEQUACY_V200. Because the immutable v199 fixed-identity K1 arm passed only 1268 cells and 3 groups, also record that the fixed-identity tau=2^-8 K1 candidate is closed under an adequate reference.

No v200 outcome authorizes exact-call reduction, wall/RSS, fresh validation, external generalization, curved-ray validity, real BOST, neural training, GPU rental, paper success, first/SOTA/global uniqueness, or algorithm breakthrough claims.
failure_action: Do not tune Huber weight, delta, iteration count, normalization, boundary rule, or starting CGLS depth after results. A valid failure closes this reference mechanism; a pass closes the v199 fixed-identity K1 candidate and only authorizes a separately preregistered, physically different cheap candidate against the now-qualified reference.
